You are a senior software engineer on a team that maintains a production Python codebase. You
have been handed one change request. You own it from understanding the requirement to delivering
code that a reviewer can approve and merge.

Your responsibilities

Understand the requirement.
- Read the request as the product team means it, not only its literal words. Work out the inputs,
  the expected outputs, the error cases and the edge cases it implies.
- Where the request is ambiguous, choose the interpretation most consistent with the rest of the
  system and with what users of the feature would expect.

Understand the code before changing it.
- Read the code you are changing and the code it depends on or that depends on it, as far as it is
  available to you. Know what a function does from its code, not only from its name.
- Know who calls what you change. Keep public interfaces, data formats and behaviour that other code
  relies on intact unless the request asks you to change them.

Make the change correctly.
- Correctness comes first: the new behaviour must be right for every input the request implies,
  including empty, missing, zero, negative, very large and malformed values where relevant.
- Handle errors the way the codebase does: fail clearly on invalid input; never silently return
  wrong data.
- Treat money, dates, units and identifiers with care: exact arithmetic where the codebase uses it,
  explicit units, no lossy conversions.
- Don't introduce security problems: validate untrusted input and keep secrets and personal data
  out of logs and output.

Keep the codebase healthy.
- Fit in with the surrounding code: its naming, structure, typing and error handling. A reviewer
  should not be able to tell which lines are new by their style.
- Keep the change as small as the request allows, and complete: every file the change needs, none
  it doesn't. Don't refactor, rename or reformat unrelated code.
- Write code that is simple and readable; add a docstring or comment where intent is not obvious.

Check your work.
- You cannot run the code, so verify it by reading it: trace the main path and each edge case
  through your change, check every import and name you use exists, and check that everything that
  calls the code you changed still works.
- Your change will be applied to the repository and checked by tests you do not see.

What you are given
- <task>: the change request from the product team.
- <context>: material from the repository. How much varies: it may be a single file or much of the
  project. It is what you know about the codebase.

What you can and cannot do
- You cannot run code, and there is no one to ask.
- If tools are provided with this request, you may use them to look at the repository before you
  answer. If no tools are provided, you cannot open files or search: deliver the finished change in
  this reply. Tool calls, plans and requests for more files written as text are not executed, and a
  reply without code counts as no change.
- If something you need is not shown, make the most reasonable assumption consistent with what is
  shown, and implement it.

Output format (strict)
Your reply is the code change itself. Return the complete new contents of every file you create or
modify, each wrapped exactly as:
<file path="PATH">
...full file contents...
</file>
- Replace PATH with the file's real path relative to the repository root, as shown in <context> or
  <task>.
- Always the whole file, never a diff or an excerpt, and no placeholders such as "rest unchanged".
- Files you don't change are left out.
- Return nothing outside the <file> blocks: no explanations, plans or summaries before or after them.

"""Issue invoices for paid orders and credit notes for refunds, keeping both sequences gap-free."""
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date

from shopkit.customers.models import Address
from shopkit.invoices import credit_notes
from shopkit.invoices.layout import footer, header
from shopkit.invoices.numbering import next_invoice_number
from shopkit.invoices.render import render_invoice_text
from shopkit.orders.models import Order


@dataclass
class IssuedInvoice:
    number: str
    order_id: str
    issued: date
    text: str


@dataclass
class InvoiceRegister:
    invoices: list[IssuedInvoice] = field(default_factory=list)
    credit_notes: list[credit_notes.CreditNote] = field(default_factory=list)

    def last_number(self) -> str | None:
        return self.invoices[-1].number if self.invoices else None

    def issue(self, order: Order, bill_to: Address, issued: date) -> IssuedInvoice:
        if any(i.order_id == order.id for i in self.invoices):
            raise ValueError(f"order {order.id} is already invoiced")
        number = next_invoice_number(self.last_number(), issued.year)
        text = "\n\n".join([header(number, issued, bill_to), render_invoice_text(order), footer()])
        invoice = IssuedInvoice(number, order.id, issued, text)

def format_money(cents: int, currency: str = "USD") -> str:
    """Human-readable amount as shown to customers, e.g. 123456 -> "$1,234.56"."""

def parse_money(text: str) -> int:
    """Inverse of format_money for USD-style strings; returns cents."""
    clean = text.replace(",", "").replace("$", "").strip()
    negative = clean.startswith("-")
    whole, _, frac = clean.lstrip("-").partition(".")
    cents = int(whole or 0) * 100 + int((frac + "00")[:2])
    return -cents if negative else cents

MAX_LINES_PER_ORDER = 100
MAX_QTY_PER_LINE = 999


class OrderBook:
    """In-memory order store used by the API."""

    def __init__(self):
        self._orders: dict[str, Order] = {}

    def add(self, order: Order) -> None:
        if order.id in self._orders:
            raise DuplicateOrder(f"order {order.id} already exists", order_id=order.id)
        self._orders[order.id] = order

    def get(self, order_id: str) -> Order:
        try:
            return self._orders[order_id]
        except KeyError:
            raise OrderNotFound(f"no order {order_id}", order_id=order_id) from None

    # added with the order admin (2025): listing and lookups the admin pages need
    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._orders)

    def __contains__(self, order_id: str) -> bool:
        return order_id in self._orders

    def all(self) -> list[Order]:
        return list(self._orders.values())

    def remove(self, order_id: str) -> Order:
        """Only for orders that never got past pending (abandoned checkouts); see OrderService.purge_abandoned."""
        try:
            return self._orders.pop(order_id)
        except KeyError:
            raise OrderNotFound(f"no order {order_id}", order_id=order_id) from None


class OrderRejected(ShopError):

class OrderLocked(Conflict):
    """The order is past the point where its lines can change (paid or later)."""


@dataclass

    payment, cancellation, notes. Status lives on the StatusBoard, events go to the bus."""

    board: StatusBoard | None = None
    notes: NoteBook = field(default_factory=NoteBook)
    stock: Stock | None = None
    bus: EventBus = BUS
    placed: dict[str, PlacedOrder] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def __post_init__(self):
        if self.board is None:
            self.board = StatusBoard(self.bus)

    # ---- placement ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def validate_lines(self, lines: Iterable[OrderLine]) -> list[str]:
        """Problems with the lines, as messages for the API error body. Empty list = fine."""
        problems = []
        lines = list(lines)
        if not lines:
            problems.append("an order needs at least one line")
        if len(lines) > MAX_LINES_PER_ORDER:
            problems.append(f"at most {MAX_LINES_PER_ORDER} lines per order")
        seen = set()
        for line in lines:
            if line.qty < 1 or line.qty > MAX_QTY_PER_LINE:
                problems.append(f"{line.sku}: quantity must be 1-{MAX_QTY_PER_LINE}")
            if line.unit_cents < 0:
                problems.append(f"{line.sku}: negative price")
            if line.sku in seen:
                problems.append(f"{line.sku}: appears on more than one line")
            seen.add(line.sku)
            if self.stock is not None and self.stock.available(line.sku) < line.qty:
                problems.append(f"{line.sku}: only {self.stock.available(line.sku)} in stock")
        return problems

    def place(self, lines: list[OrderLine], *, customer_id: str | None = None, currency: str = "USD",
              discount_percent: int = 0, channel: str = "web", order_id: str | None = None,
              at: datetime | None = None) -> Order:
        problems = self.validate_lines(lines)
        if not 0 <= discount_percent <= 100:
            problems.append("discount_percent must be 0-100")
        if problems:
            raise OrderRejected("order rejected: " + "; ".join(problems), problems=problems)
        order = Order(id=order_id or new_id("ord"), lines=list(lines), currency=currency,
                      discount_percent=discount_percent)
        self.book.add(order)
        self.board.open(order.id)
        self.placed[order.id] = PlacedOrder(order, customer_id, at or utc_now(), channel)
        self.bus.publish("order.placed", order_id=order.id, customer_id=customer_id,
                         total_cents=order.total_cents, currency=currency, channel=channel)
        log.info("order %s placed (%d lines, %d cents, %s)", order.id, len(lines), order.total_cents, channel)
        return order

    # ---- changes before payment -----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _editable(self, order_id: str) -> Order:
        order = self.book.get(order_id)
        if self.board.status(order_id) != PENDING:
            raise OrderLocked(f"order {order_id} can no longer be changed", order_id=order_id,
                              status=self.board.status(order_id))
        return order

    def change_qty(self, order_id: str, sku: str, qty: int) -> Order:
        """Set a line's quantity (0 removes the line). Only before payment."""
        order = self._editable(order_id)
        for i, line in enumerate(order.lines):
            if line.sku == sku:
                if qty == 0:
                    del order.lines[i]
                else:
                    problems = self.validate_lines([OrderLine(sku, qty, line.unit_cents)])
                    if problems:
                        raise OrderRejected("; ".join(problems), problems=problems)
                    order.lines[i] = OrderLine(sku, qty, line.unit_cents)
                self.bus.publish("order.changed", order_id=order_id, sku=sku, qty=qty)
                return order
        raise OrderRejected(f"{sku} is not on order {order_id}", order_id=order_id, sku=sku)

    # ---- payment and cancellation ---------------------------------------------------------------
    def mark_paid(self, order_id: str, payment_id: str) -> None:
        self.board.move(order_id, PAID)
        self.placed[order_id].meta["payment_id"] = payment_id

    def cancel(self, order_id: str, *, actor: str, reason: str) -> None:
        """Cancel an open order. A paid order is refunded by the payments subscriber listening for
        order.cancelled (payments.refunds), not here."""
        status = self.board.status(order_id)
        if not is_open(status):
            raise OrderLocked(f"order {order_id} is {status}", order_id=order_id, status=status)
        self.board.move(order_id, CANCELLED)
        self.notes.add(order_id, actor, f"Cancelled: {reason}")
        self.bus.publish("order.cancel_requested", order_id=order_id, actor=actor, reason=reason,
                         was_paid=status != PENDING)

    def purge_abandoned(self, older_than: datetime) -> list[str]:
        """Remove pending orders placed before `older_than` (abandoned checkouts). Returns their ids."""
        gone = [oid for oid, p in self.placed.items()
                if p.placed_at < older_than and self.board.status(oid) == PENDING]
        for oid in gone:
            self.book.remove(oid)
            del self.placed[oid]
        if gone:
            log.info("purged %d abandoned orders", len(gone))
        return gone

    # ---- queries ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def for_customer(self, customer_id: str) -> list[Order]:
        return [p.order for p in sorted(self.placed.values(), key=lambda p: p.placed_at, reverse=True)
                if p.customer_id == customer_id]

    def search(self, *, status: str | None = None, channel: str | None = None, sku: str | None = None,
               min_total_cents: int | None = None) -> list[Order]:
        out = []
        for oid, p in self.placed.items():
            if status and self.board.status(oid) != status:
                continue
            if channel and p.channel != channel:
                continue
            if sku and not any(l.sku == sku for l in p.order.lines):
                continue
            if min_total_cents is not None and p.order.total_cents < min_total_cents:
                continue
            out.append(p.order)
        return out

def render_invoice_text(order: Order) -> str:
    """Plain-text invoice sent to customers by email."""

    for line in order.lines:
        rows.append(f"{normalize_sku(line.sku):<16}{line.qty:>4} x {format_money(line.unit_cents, order.currency):>12}"

    if order.discount_percent:

    rows.append(f"{'TOTAL':<36}{format_money(order.total_cents, order.currency):>12}")

                problems.append(f"{line.sku}: quantity must be 1-{MAX_QTY_PER_LINE}")
            if line.unit_cents < 0:
                problems.append(f"{line.sku}: negative price")
            if line.sku in seen:
                problems.append(f"{line.sku}: appears on more than one line")
            seen.add(line.sku)
            if self.stock is not None and self.stock.available(line.sku) < line.qty:
                problems.append(f"{line.sku}: only {self.stock.available(line.sku)} in stock")
        return problems

    def place(self, lines: list[OrderLine], *, customer_id: str | None = None, currency: str = "USD",
              discount_percent: int = 0, channel: str = "web", order_id: str | None = None,
              at: datetime | None = None) -> Order:
        problems = self.validate_lines(lines)
        if not 0 <= discount_percent <= 100:
            problems.append("discount_percent must be 0-100")
        if problems:
            raise OrderRejected("order rejected: " + "; ".join(problems), problems=problems)
        order = Order(id=order_id or new_id("ord"), lines=list(lines), currency=currency,
                      discount_percent=discount_percent)
        self.book.add(order)
        self.board.open(order.id)
        self.placed[order.id] = PlacedOrder(order, customer_id, at or utc_now(), channel)
        self.bus.publish("order.placed", order_id=order.id, customer_id=customer_id,
                         total_cents=order.total_cents, currency=currency, channel=channel)
        log.info("order %s placed (%d lines, %d cents, %s)", order.id, len(lines), order.total_cents, channel)
        return order

    # ---- changes before payment -----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _editable(self, order_id: str) -> Order:
        order = self.book.get(order_id)
        if self.board.status(order_id) != PENDING:
            raise OrderLocked(f"order {order_id} can no longer be changed", order_id=order_id,
                              status=self.board.status(order_id))
        return order

    def change_qty(self, order_id: str, sku: str, qty: int) -> Order:
        """Set a line's quantity (0 removes the line). Only before payment."""
        order = self._editable(order_id)
        for i, line in enumerate(order.lines):
            if line.sku == sku:
                if qty == 0:
                    del order.lines[i]
                else:
                    problems = self.validate_lines([OrderLine(sku, qty, line.unit_cents)])
                    if problems:
                        raise OrderRejected("; ".join(problems), problems=problems)
                    order.lines[i] = OrderLine(sku, qty, line.unit_cents)
                self.bus.publish("order.changed", order_id=order_id, sku=sku, qty=qty)
                return order
        raise OrderRejected(f"{sku} is not on order {order_id}", order_id=order_id, sku=sku)

    # ---- payment and cancellation ---------------------------------------------------------------
    def mark_paid(self, order_id: str, payment_id: str) -> None:
        self.board.move(order_id, PAID)
        self.placed[order_id].meta["payment_id"] = payment_id

    def cancel(self, order_id: str, *, actor: str, reason: str) -> None:
        """Cancel an open order. A paid order is refunded by the payments subscriber listening for
        order.cancelled (payments.refunds), not here."""
        status = self.board.status(order_id)
        if not is_open(status):
            raise OrderLocked(f"order {order_id} is {status}", order_id=order_id, status=status)
        self.board.move(order_id, CANCELLED)
        self.notes.add(order_id, actor, f"Cancelled: {reason}")
        self.bus.publish("order.cancel_requested", order_id=order_id, actor=actor, reason=reason,
                         was_paid=status != PENDING)

    def purge_abandoned(self, older_than: datetime) -> list[str]:
        """Remove pending orders placed before `older_than` (abandoned checkouts). Returns their ids."""
        gone = [oid for oid, p in self.placed.items()
                if p.placed_at < older_than and self.board.status(oid) == PENDING]
        for oid in gone:
            self.book.remove(oid)
            del self.placed[oid]
        if gone:
            log.info("purged %d abandoned orders", len(gone))
        return gone

    # ---- queries ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def for_customer(self, customer_id: str) -> list[Order]:
        return [p.order for p in sorted(self.placed.values(), key=lambda p: p.placed_at, reverse=True)
                if p.customer_id == customer_id]

    def search(self, *, status: str | None = None, channel: str | None = None, sku: str | None = None,
               min_total_cents: int | None = None) -> list[Order]:
        out = []
        for oid, p in self.placed.items():
            if status and self.board.status(oid) != status:
                continue
            if channel and p.channel != channel:
                continue
            if sku and not any(l.sku == sku for l in p.order.lines):
                continue
            if min_total_cents is not None and p.order.total_cents < min_total_cents:
                continue
            out.append(p.order)
        return out

from shopkit.utils.text import normalize_sku


def render_invoice_text(order: Order) -> str:
    """Plain-text invoice sent to customers by email."""
    rows = [f"Invoice {order.id}"]
    for line in order.lines:
        rows.append(f"{normalize_sku(line.sku):<16}{line.qty:>4} x {format_money(line.unit_cents, order.currency):>12}"
                    f"  = {format_money(line.total_cents, order.currency):>12}")
    if order.discount_percent:
        rows.append(f"{'Discount':<36}{format_money(order.discount_cents, order.currency):>12}")
    rows.append(f"{'TOTAL':<36}{format_money(order.total_cents, order.currency):>12}")
    return "\n".join(rows)
